summary: After a range-preserving direct dev-tool refresh reduced the audit from 34 to 26 advisories, add only audit-named transitive patch overrides. Preserve direct manifest ranges, Probity 1.10.1, Codex SDK 0.161.0, and the CLI zero-runtime-dependency contract.
evidence: Red audit: 34 advisory records (11 high); pnpm update -D --no-save eslint typescript-eslint vitest left manifests unchanged and post-audit reports 26 (7 high). Official pnpm update semantics require overrides for explicit indirect versions. Each candidate is constrained to the vulnerable installed-version/range and will be admitted only after parent compatibility inspection and post-update audit.
